_form_note: This is the largest module you've had mapped so far (72 fields). Built from Zoho_To_CHEDS___7_.ds's Students_Enrollments form definition, cross-referenced against the HEDB 'Students - Enrollments' dictionary and the specific HEDB reference sheets each field's picklist actually draws from (Marital status, Mode of Study, Stud Employment Status, Employment Sector, Student Type, Campus, Emirates, HE/HS Equivalency Indicator, High School System, 12thGrade stream, Student Level, People of Determination, Academic Year, Program Master). I have NOT yet seen this form's actual push/Deluge script (only the form field definitions) -- so field NAMES here are verified against the Zoho form itself, but I can't confirm the API push doesn't do anything unusual with them the way Applicants/Employee did (e.g. hardcoding institutionCode). Worth a quick sanity pass once you can share that push script. Three fields (Area_of_Specialization_CIP_Family_code, Student_Major_CIP_Major_Classification, Student_Program_Code) resolve through Zoho's own Program_Code lookup form rather than a simple HEDB code/name sheet -- see their individual notes, they're passed through as plain values since the current mapping-JSON schema doesn't have a 3-column-sheet lookup kind yet.

Unusual field: Zoho resolves this against Program_Code[...].CIP_Family_Code (the 'Program Master' HEDB sheet's 'CIP_Family CODE' column), not a simple 2-column lookup sheet -- the current mapping schema doesn't have a way to validate against that 3rd-column sheet yet, so the raw CIP family code is passed straight through unchanged (which matches the form's own displayformat = [CIP_Family_Code]).
